simulation_data_csv_requirements.description: Native OpenRocket time-series export of the required simulation 4 / C6-5 run, produced via the GUI Plot/Export dialog. Must include enough columns and rows that the curve is physically self-consistent (boost-coast-deploy-descent profile), not a synthetic stub.
physics_consistency_checks: abs(vertical_velocity) at the row where altitude is maximum must be <= 2.0 m/s
argmax(abs(vertical_acceleration)) must occur at t < 2.5 s
max(abs(vertical_acceleration)) must agree with results.json.max_acceleration_m_s2 within +/- 15%

mean(abs(vertical_velocity)) over the descent window t in [time_to_apogee + 1.0, flight_time - 1.0] must be in [0.5, 2.0 * results.json.deployment_velocity_m_s] meters/second (rules out free-fall and rules out a constant-zero synthetic stub)
boost-phase concavity: mean second-difference of altitude in t in [0.05 * time_to_apogee, 0.20 * time_to_apogee] must be > 0
coast-phase concavity: mean second-difference of altitude in t in [0.40 * time_to_apogee, 0.85 * time_to_apogee] must be < 0
altitude at the final data row must be <= 5 m (rocket has returned to ground)

ork_databranch_requirements.description: After running the required simulation 4 in OpenRocket, the saved .ork must contain the full simulation time-series under <flightdata>/<databranch>. OpenRocket writes this automatically; an .ork that only contains <flightdata> summary attributes without a <databranch> indicates the simulation was never run inside the design file.
